\begin{equation} (\widehat R_{ijkl})=e^{-2f}\left[ (R_{ijkl})+ \begin{pmatrix} -\dfrac {q^2}{s^4}f^2 & 0 \\ 0 & \left(\dfrac {q^2}{s^4}-\dfrac {2q}{s^3}\right)fI_2 \end{pmatrix} +\frac q{s^2}fO(\delta )\right]. \end{equation} Moreover, \[ \widehat R=e^{2f}\left[ R+4\left(\frac{q^2}{s^4}-\frac{2q}{s^3}\right)f -2\frac{q^2}{s^4}f^2+\frac q{s^2}fO(\delta )\right]. \]

Proof

\sketch Insert the displayed first- and second-derivative estimates for $f$ into Equation (7). The $00$ Hessian term supplies the positive $2\times 2$ block, the gradient-square term supplies the negative scalar block, and all mixed terms are absorbed into $qfO(\delta )/s^2$. Tracing the conformal formula gives the scalar-curvature identity.

□

Corollary
[Scalar curvature does not decrease under the surgery conformal factor]
